results.title: Kaalipotka
results.overview: In a gritty urban jungle, four women - Srima, Rani, Rinku, and Minoti - are drawn into chaos after Minoti's husband's freak accident. A cover-up spirals into deceit, murder, and revenge as ex-con Rana and the police hunt them.

results.title: That Burning House
results.overview: At Home of Happiness, a devoted social worker struggles to reform troubled youth while the institution falls into crisis. A bullied boy clings to his late mother’s teddy bear as his world collapses. A former resident, lured into a telecom scam, faces a moral dilemma that threatens his life. Across different paths, each must confront the scars of the past and decide whether to fall into darkness or fight for a way forward.

results.title: Pani Vizhum Iravu
results.overview: During a trip to a century-old Kodaikanal bungalow, JK reports his lover Shabi mysteriously missing, triggering a tense police inquiry entangled with an unsolved murder, suspicious staff, and local thieves. However, as the investigation deepens, the boundary between reality and illusion shatters, exposing a harrowing confrontation with unresolved grief, guilt, and the fragile human mind.

results.title: First Death
results.overview: Dead and down-bad, Margot makes one last play for eternal love with the avoidant woman she loved on earth.

results.title: The Acres
results.overview: Christine enters The Acres estate with gardening tools and a plan, but then she encounters Ama, a lonely new mother. Ama reminds Christine of the early days of motherhood, a simpler time before things took a turn.

results.title: Downbeat
results.overview: After fleeing his mistakes in Atlanta to crash with his sister in Boston, a self-destructive street bucket drummer repeatedly undermines his own fresh start, dragging everyone around him into the fallout of his feral behavior.

results.title: Mambo Kids
results.overview: On a quiet late-summer day, Alessandro and Flavio set out in search of the last secrets of their city. Sitting on the branch of a large cherry tree, they wait for the night. A beer with friends, mopeds heading home, and a farewell.

results.title: Slackers
results.overview: A slingshot is loaded, the stone flies and crashes - the neighbor's window breaks. Ramona and Nico are friends, lazy bums and fresh out of school. But instead of thinking about their future, they prefer to let the hot Berlin summer get the better of them. When they release a beloved neighbor's bird, they have to flee - into the politically charged world that they really don't want to be in. A road trip through Berlin begins - but on foot.

results.title: Bound to My Hot Rival
results.overview: Shane never planned on crossing Roman Volkov. Now he belongs to his rival, his enemy, his captor. And the worst part? He's starting to want to.

results.title: Canadian Baby
results.overview: Four roommates spend the night drinking.

results.title: My Lord
results.overview: A man and his wife battle bureaucracy after being wrongly declared dead, while he confronts a kidney trafficking ring connected to corrupt politicians that destroyed his life.

results.title: Talking Tom Hero’s on the Big Screen
results.original_title: Talking Tom Hero’s on the Big Screen
results.overview: Talking Tom Heroes are coming to the big screen! An hour-long show featuring your very favourite episodes of the hit series and never-seen-before surprises!

results.title: The Fort
results.overview: In a world destroyed by war, pandemics, and disaster, a small group of survivors finds refuge inside a rebuilt stronghold known as The Fort. As darkness rises and deception spreads, the community must stand together in faith and courage to defend their last haven and fight for truth, hope, and the future of mankind.

results.title: Macumbaria
results.overview: The mystical element plays an unusual role in the civilizing process of Brazilian society. Realms such as samba, malandragem, soccer, and Carnival reflect this process, which unfolded in the shadow of the Precarious. On the street, in the terreiro, at the bar, in the favela, at the crossroads, or on the floodplain—a multifaceted historical and cultural identity was forged, resulting from the intersection of Amerindian and African spiritualities and European popular Catholicism. Macumbaria explores the phenomenon of the “macumba complex” through the lens of historian Luiz Antonio Simas, the film’s narrator.

results.title: Just One More
results.overview: A recovering addict, Jess, meets Charles, a dying man praying God will use him "just one more" time. As their lives collide, Jess battles shame, and doubt-discovering faith, forgiveness, and the hope to fight for a future beyond addiction.

results.title: Boy George & Culture Club
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of 1980s Britain, four young men – Boy George, Roy Hay, Mikey Craig, and Jon Moss – formed a multi-racial, ethnically diverse, and sexually liberated band with a style and sound that challenged the status quo during the era of New Romantics and Margaret Thatcher’s Britain.

results.title: 60 Dates in 6 Months
results.overview: A widowed woman in her 50s, recovering from a neck injury, sets out to go on 60 dates in six months-facing bad matches, worse advice, and unexpected healing in her hilariously messy comeback to modern love.

results.title: The mystery of Father Metz
results.overview: Perpetually relegated to the kids’ section, aspiring journalist Amélie tries to make the front page by uncovering the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of a local folk hero.

results.title: Summer's Camera
results.overview: After her father passed away, Summer stopped taking photos. One day, she falls for Yeonwoo, the school's soccer star, and takes her picture with her late father's camera. When she develops the film, she finds mysterious photos of her father's high school lover. In these photos, Summer uncovers a secret about her father. Will she be able to pursue her first love and uncover her father's hidden truth?
